skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 24% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Watchdog Man unleashes a rapid chase-combo on the target, each hit dealing 150% ATK [Chase DMG]. The combo grows with his [Rampage] stacks, escalating from 4 up to 13 consecutive hits.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Chase-combo ATK per hit 150% > 180%. Still escalates from 4 up to 13 consecutive [Chase DMG] hits.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% HP. On entry, gains +20% Crit (3 rounds). On a max-multiplier hit, inflicts [Disabled] on the target's column.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Disabled] range on max-multiplier hit: target's column > selected area.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Disabled] range on max-multiplier hit: selected area > selected area.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, permanently grant 70% chance of [Evade] (Reduce Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1 DMG). After any character acts, if Watchdogman triggered [Evade], adds 1 consecutive strike.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: After any character acts, if Watchdogman triggered [Evade], increases 30% ATK for self for 1 round.

effects.desc: The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
This type of attack damage is dealt as Attack attacks in a series of rapid attacks, gradually increasing the number of consecutive attacks.
Disabled status applies to a target area/column, rendering affected units unable to act or be effective.
